eyebrow: A real orders.sql mart (dbt Labs' own example)
code:
with orders as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
),
summary as (
    select order_id,
        sum(supply_cost) as order_cost,
        count(order_item_id) as count_order_items
    from {{ ref('order_items') }}
    group by 1
)
select orders.*, summary.order_cost,
    summary.count_order_items
from orders
left join summary on orders.order_id = summary.order_id
caption: Marts can build on other marts — but 4-5+ joins means push it to intermediate.
